name: PolygonL1Switchboard
title: The Ghost of Shanghai's Switchboard
tagline: A lingering spirit born in November, silent since its final call on the chain.

chapters.heading: The ghost of the switchboard
paragraphs: Candles flicker over the memory of November 16, 2023. A wallet ending in 6d34 brought the PolygonL1Switchboard into the world. It is a small program that lives on Ethereum. On the day it was born, it was written into a block, one page of Ethereum's shared record book.
The Shanghai era was its cradle. It was written in Solidity 0.8.19. Now it sits quietly at about 2.9 years old. It remains a still shadow in the long chain.

chapters.heading: The pulse of the switchboard
paragraphs: The contract sits in the light of 2024. It stays active every year. People reached out to it with 1159 transactions.
They used it to nominateOwner. They used it to setFees. It remains a steady presence on the chain.

chapters.heading: The knocking
paragraphs: The contract sits in the dark. It holds 0.0 ETH for the world. It remains on the chain like a stone in a river.
People still reach out to it. They nominate a new owner or change the fees. These voices are quiet now.

It carries two old scars. A door left open for a caller to step back in mid-call and a clock the block maker can nudge. The ghost buster says to close the door for the whole function and use a commit-reveal scheme.
